name: BedCapacityExampleCodeMap
title: NHSN SAFR Bed Capacity Codes ConceptMap
description: Maps HL7 US SAFR ballot (May 2025) example bed capacity codes to the final LOINC codes adopted for use in the published US SAFR Implementation Guide and the CDC NHSN SAFR Content Implementation Guide.
purpose: Supports implementers transitioning from HL7 US SAFR ballot example bed capacity codes to the final LOINC terminology.
